pullRequest.title: feat(sleep): Sleep Image Order setting — Random or In Order

nodes.body:
Walkthrough
Adds a Display setting for random or sequential sleep image order. Sequential selection scans standard sleep images in both configured directories, advances by path order, and wraps to the first path. **Changes: Sleep Image Order** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Order setting**
`src/CrossPointSettings.h`, `src/SettingsList.cpp`, `lib/I18n/translations/english.yaml`, `lib/I18n/translations/russian.yaml`|Adds random and sequential order choices, with random as the default. Registers the choices in Display settings and adds English and Russian labels.| |**Sequential selection**
`src/activities/boot_sleep/SleepActivity.cpp`|Scans both configured directories for valid BMP images. Selects the first path greater than the saved path, or wraps to the first image. Saves the selected path and uses sequential selection when enabled; otherwise, selection remains random.| **Estimated code review effort:** 3 (Moderate) | ~20 minutes **Change:** Feature ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant renderCustomSleepScreen participant selectNextSleepFileInOrder participant SleepImageDirectories participant sleep_last_txt renderCustomSleepScreen->>selectNextSleepFileInOrder: request next image when sequential order is enabled selectNextSleepFileInOrder->>sleep_last_txt: read previously selected path selectNextSleepFileInOrder->>SleepImageDirectories: scan for valid BMP images selectNextSleepFileInOrder->>sleep_last_txt: save selected path ``` **Possibly related PRs** - [crosspoint-reader/crosspoint-reader#4327](https://github.com/crosspoint-reader/crosspoint-reader/pull/4327): Documents custom sleep-image selection and the random-selection behavior. - [crosspoint-reader/crosspoint-reader#3841](https://github.com/crosspoint-reader/crosspoint-reader/pull/3841): Changes random selection and recent-image tracking in the same selection behavior. - [crosspoint-reader/crosspoint-reader#4265](https://github.com/crosspoint-reader/crosspoint-reader/pull/4265): Adds wallpaper-pack images to the custom sleep-screen selection flow. **Suggested reviewers:** `jadehawk`, `itsthisjustin`, `uri-tauber`
Merge Risk: Low · up to 4a5ac
Sequential sleep images may repeat if saving the last image fails. Normal selection remains unaffected; this bounded edge case can be accepted with follow-up.

**A failed `sleep_last.txt` write can repeat the same sleep image.** In sequential mode, `writeFile` failure at lines 542-545 logs the error and still returns `true`. The next sleep reads the cursor from disk. A missing or empty cursor selects the first image again. An unchanged cursor selects the same successor again. While the write keeps failing, sleeps can repeat the same image. Keeping the selected path in a RAM variable does not prevent this. Sleep enters deep sleep, and wake restarts the firmware, so ordinary RAM is cleared before the next selection. A fix needs state that survives deep sleep, such as RTC memory. It also needs a rule for choosing between that state and the disk cursor when both exist.
